missions.title: Explore a plane mirror
missions.goalText: Move the light source. Watch the reflected ray and compare the source with its virtual image.

observe-prompt.default: Find the mirror, the light source, the ray, and the virtual image. Continue when you are ready.

observe-hint-1.default: Look for the solid and dashed ray paths.

observe-hint-2.default: The hollow marker is the virtual image.

observe-hint-3.default: The mirror separates the source from its image.

relationship-prompt.default: The angles are measured from the normal, the line at right angles to the mirror. Compare the two angle readouts.

relationship-hint-1.default: Find the normal at the reflection point.

relationship-hint-2.default: Compare each ray with the normal.

predict-prompt.default: Before moving the source, predict how the angle of incidence compares with the angle of reflection.

predict-hint-1.default: Think about how each angle is measured.

predict-hint-2.default: Both angles use the normal as their reference.

predict-hint-3.default: Choose the relationship you expect to observe.

move-prompt.default: Drag the light source or change its distance. Watch both rays update.

move-hint-1.default: Use the source marker or distance slider.

move-hint-2.default: Move the source away from the mirror.

move-hint-3.default: Move the source to a new distance from the mirror.

measure-prompt.default: Enter the difference between the two displayed angles, in degrees.

measure-hint-1.default: Read both angle values beside the scene.

measure-hint-2.default: Subtract the smaller displayed angle from the larger one.

measure-hint-3.default: Enter 0 if the displayed angles match.

record-prompt.default: Record whether the two angle values match and whether the source and image are equally far from the mirror.

record-hint-1.default: Compare the incidence and reflection readouts.

record-hint-2.default: Compare the source distance with the image distance readout.

conclude-prompt.default: Which relationship between the angle of incidence and the angle of reflection did the scene show?

conclude-hint-3.default: Choose the relationship that matches the readouts.

check-prompt.default: Your conclusion is recorded. Continue to finish this guided walkthrough.

check-hint-2.default: Use the angle readouts as evidence.
